note: Paper FPS weapon numbers (Unity-portable). Applied over the engine's built-in table at load by modules/paper.js (this file wins). dmg = per bullet/pellet vs 100 HP; head = headshot multiplier; rpm = rounds per minute; falloff = [full-damage metres, min-damage metres, min multiplier]; reload/reloadEmpty in seconds. Engine ids kept for online compatibility: carbine = assault rifle, breacher = pump shotgun, sniper = sniper, wasp = SMG, boomerang = boomerang. optic = what you aim through: 'reflex' (digital red-dot: shows the ADS dot), 'iron' (paper sights: no dot, the sight lines up with screen centre), 'scope' (sniper scope).

carbine.name: Fold-47
carbine.desc: Folded blue card rifle. Steady at every range.

breacher.name: Crease Pump
breacher.desc: Eight paper pellets. Shreds anyone within 7 m.

sniper.name: Longfold
sniper.desc: Bolt-action. Head, body or arm shot kills, a leg shot leaves them on a sliver. Instant paper-tube scope, 0.75 s bolt (switch weapons to skip it).

wasp.name: Snip-9
wasp.desc: Fast and light. Shreds up close, weak past 15 m.

boomerang.name: Bend-Back
boomerang.desc: Hold to wind up, release to throw. Cuts through anyone in its path and flies back to your hand. Right click = blade punch.

rules._note: PLANES.R overrides (docs/MECHANICS.md section 5). m, s, rad/s; catchConeDeg = half-angle of the catch cone in degrees; catchSlow = slow motion after YOUR catch (s).
